name: reskin-for-claude
description: Unofficial colour skins for the Claude desktop app: a light flavour through official mod colours, and the full flavour for the whole app (macOS).

plugins.name: reskin-light
plugins.description: Reskin light: /skin <name> colours the Code tab with one of 16 skins through official mod colours. No Developer menu, survives restarts.

plugins.name: skin
plugins.description: Reskin full: /skin <name> recolours the whole Claude desktop app (macOS) with one of 16 skins, each light and dark, plus fonts and bigger sidebar headers.
